development_plan.alternative_weighting: Equal prior weights; mirrored alternatives have identical cost by symmetry.
development_plan.selection_policy: Run one LP with the fixed grid, horizon, cost and constraints. Save all fixed classical controls without choosing a favorable subset. Abort on exact feasibility failure; do not retune constraints after seeing results.
development_plan.objective: Minimize equal-alternative mean expected discordances over all paths, including wrong reports and terminal abstentions.
development_plan.allowed_actions: At each non-tie state: report majority sign with a frozen state-dependent probability, otherwise continue; at H continue becomes terminal abstention. At ties continue or terminal abstention. No early abstention, no truth input, no data-dependent prior.

numerical_policy.acceptance: Round policy probabilities once under this fixed rule, then require exact rational null<=.01 and each design q correct>=.95; optimization feasibility is not certification.

development_plan.fairness: All 12 classical controls receive exact null calibration at the same H and .01 budget; the LP is an additional classical optimized control, not an exclusive FaultTune method. LP design-grid performance is in-sample development, not independent confirmation.
development_plan.physical_scope: This prototype minimizes discordances, not physical shots. A physical cap and discordance waiting process need explicit integration before a physical-cost advantage claim.

prior_art.title: Optimal Alpha Spending for Sequential Analysis with Binomial Data
prior_art.relation: Classical finite-horizon optimization prior art; this local occupancy formulation is not asserted to reproduce the paper's exact algorithm.

protocol.action: Report the current majority sign iff a fresh independent uniform integer U in [0,10^12) is below policy_numerators[d][j]; otherwise continue. At H any non-report is terminal abstention.
protocol.risk_scope: Uniform fair conditional discordant-sign null through this H; the symmetric policy's exact iid-fair calculation applies to conditionally fair signs with independent policy coins. The H cap must never be exceeded.

solver.claim: A numerical optimum of the specified LP before rounding, not an exact optimality certificate and not a universal optimum.

beta_exact.orientation: [00, plus-only, minus-only, 11]; plus score reports reject
beta_exact.physical_budget_scope: A 2*N physical-shot cap guarantees D<=N; the caller enforces its physical cap. This module directly enforces only the discordance cap.
beta_exact.boundary_encoding: B[n]; stop reject at s>=B[n], accept at s<=n-B[n]; B[n]=n+1 means no crossing

fair_null_risk.arithmetic: Exact integer path counts; float probability is display only
Exact integer path counts; float probability is display only

beta_exact.validity: Uniform wrong-sign control through discordance N under predictable commonly ordered pairs. Fair latent all-index crossing controls sparse or adaptive physical monitoring; do not condition on terminal D.
beta_exact.scope: Threshold selection uses only N, delta, and the declared deterministic lattice. No simulator data. Finite discordance horizon; no continuation or performance claim.
